hero.body: Save the videos, sounds, and moments that matter—for personal offline access, in the format you choose.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need. Nothing you don’t.
landing.featuresBody: Powerful media tools, shaped into a focused and beautifully simple workflow.

save: Keep the media that matters, ready whenever you are.
convert: Choose clean, compatible video and audio formats.
organize: Find every saved file in one calm, searchable library.
process: Clip ranges, tune quality, and handle playlists with precision.

paste: Drop in a link from a supported platform.
format: Choose the quality and output you want.
keep: Download it for personal offline access.

landing.ctaBody: Start free. Keep the moments you care about.

footer.tagline: Freedom to keep what you love.
footer.notice: Loady is a personal media utility for content you own or are otherwise authorized to access and download. It is not intended to bypass copy protection, DRM, or paywalls.
footer.copyrightLine: © {{year}} Loady. Not affiliated with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.body: Start free. Upgrade when you need higher quality, more downloads, or creator tools.
pricing.sandbox: Billing runs on Paddle Sandbox in this build - no real payment is ever collected. Prices shown are the planned production prices.
